text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Queen Elizabeth II Cup approaches. 
Rhein Kraft takes her steps toward the 
dream race alongside Cesario, who has made 
her comeback from injury.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hearing the crowd cheer for the Tiara 
Umamusume, Rhein Kraft remembers—she 
started running by following the line her 
predecessors left behind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She has come this far searching for her 
own path. And now, there are juniors like 
Kawakami Princess chasing after the backs 
of Line Craft and the others.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The feelings of Umamusume will continue to 
connect, weaving the tapestry of the 
future—and Rine Kraft heads onto that turf 
together with everyone.
